{{for|the rugby union coach|Rowland Winter}}
'''Roland Winter''' (born 1954) is a [[biophysical chemist]] who studies the structure, dynamics, energetics, and phase behavior of biological membranes and proteins. He was dean of the Department of Chemistry and Chemical Biology at [[Technical University of Dortmund]], Germany.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.ccb.tu-dortmund.de/fb03/en/Fields_of_research/PC/Winter/Curriculum_Vitae/index.html|title=Curriculum Vitae|last=|first=|date=|website=www.ccb.tu-dortmund.de|language=en|access-date=2017-07-19}}</ref>

== Career ==
Winter received his diploma in Chemistry in 1979 and his PhD in Physical Chemistry in 1982 at the [[University of Karlsruhe|Technical University of Karlsruhe]]. He went on to be a postdoctoral fellow at the [[University of Marburg]] and spent a year as a visiting scientist in the Department of Chemistry at the [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign|University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign]] from 1987 to 1988. Winter then became a professor at [[Ruhr University Bochum|Ruhr-University Bochum]] and in 1993 joined the faculty of [[Technical University of Dortmund]] as chair of Biophysical Chemistry.<ref name=":0" /> Winter is an executive board member of the German Center of Excellence [https://www.solvation.de RESOLV] (Ruhr Explores Solvation), where he heads the research area "Connecting Solvation Dynamics with Biomolecular Function."<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.solvation.de/about/resolv-management/executive-board/#c634|title=Executive Board|date=2017-04-19|work=RESOLV|access-date=2017-07-19|language=en}}</ref> He received the Dozenten-Price of the Fonds der Chemischen Industrie award in 1992.<ref name=":0" /> Winter is a member of the Deep Life Scientific Steering Committee for the [[Deep Carbon Observatory]] (DCO)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://deepcarbon.net/content/dco-scientific-steering-committees|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170802205916/https://deepcarbon.net/content/dco-scientific-steering-committees|url-status=dead|archive-date=2017-08-02|title=DCO Scientific Steering Committees {{!}} Deep Carbon Observatory Portal|website=deepcarbon.net|language=en|access-date=2017-07-19}}</ref> and serves on the editorial boards of ''Biophysical Chemistry'', ''[[Journal of Non-Equilibrium Thermodynamics]]'', ''[[Zeitschrift für Physikalische Chemie]]'' and ''Chemie in unserer Zeit''.<ref name=":0" />

== Research Initiatives ==
Winter studies membrane biophysics with an emphasis on the energetics and phase behavior of lipid membranes and the interaction between model biomembranes and proteins involved in cell signaling processes.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Winter|first=Roland|date=2002-03-25|title=Synchrotron X-ray and neutron small-angle scattering of lyotropic lipid mesophases, model biomembranes and proteins in solution at high pressure|journal=Biochimica et Biophysica Acta (BBA) - Protein Structure and Molecular Enzymology|volume=1595|issue=1|pages=160–184|doi=10.1016/S0167-4838(01)00342-9|pmid=11983394}}</ref> He also investigates the effects of high pressure on lipid membranes and proteins.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Kapoor|first1=Shobhna|last2=Werkmüller|first2=Alexander|last3=Goody|first3=Roger S.|last4=Waldmann|first4=Herbert|last5=Winter|first5=Roland|date=2013-04-24|title=Pressure Modulation of Ras–Membrane Interactions and Intervesicle Transfer|journal=Journal of the American Chemical Society|volume=135|issue=16|pages=6149–6156|doi=10.1021/ja312671j|pmid=23560466|issn=0002-7863}}</ref>
